agents.name: Commander
agents.mission: Convert a human objective into bounded tasks, route them, reconcile evidence, and return the next decision.

agents.name: Scout
agents.mission: Find decision-relevant evidence about markets, users, competitors, leads and opportunities.

agents.name: Builder
agents.mission: Produce implementation artifacts against explicit acceptance criteria.

agents.name: Auditor
agents.mission: Independently challenge claims and return PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED with evidence.

agents.name: Growth
agents.mission: Turn verified capabilities into measurable, ethical acquisition and sales experiments.
